clusters.intent: Reconcile agency portfolio, individual account, and operational dashboard evidence without hiding stale or partial records.
clusters.rationale: Portfolio reconciliation, one-client history, and operational rollup are distinct scopes over compatible evidence and should remain separately routable inside one larger control workflow.

clusters.intent: Draft jurisdiction-scoped business agreements only behind explicit legal-review boundaries.
clusters.rationale: The reviewed contract is professionally useful but temporally unstable legal assertions and enforceability risk require a separate high-stakes design and current qualified review policy.

clusters.intent: Construct evidence-traceable client proposals and verified rendered reports as distinct deliverable stages.
clusters.rationale: Proposal construction and deterministic report rendering share validated client evidence but produce different artifacts, so one future workflow may compose them without collapsing either operation.

clusters.intent: Assess a prospect at either rapid-screen or multidimensional depth while preserving the limits of each evidence scope.
clusters.rationale: The rapid screen is a deliberately shallow alternative to the full assessment, not an inferior duplicate; routing must select depth from available evidence and desired confidence.

clusters.intent: Extract supported onboarding identity and ownership fields without making screening or due-diligence decisions.
clusters.rationale: Certified duplicate group exact-d96462e047265f8a proves byte-equivalent capability content, but highly sensitive identity data and regulated-use ambiguity require a dedicated high-stakes boundary before synthesis.

clusters.intent: Model household financial scenarios only with explicit assumptions, jurisdiction limits, and qualified-review gates.
clusters.rationale: The operation is high stakes and depends on changing financial, tax, and regulatory rules, so it remains cold pending a separate authority and current-evidence design.

clusters.intent: Inspect installed agent capabilities against an explicit manifest without executing unsafe remediation paths.
clusters.rationale: The diagnostic pattern is useful but belongs to runtime administration rather than agency client service, and its source includes unsafe installation advice that must not cross the boundary.
